translations.web: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
translations.bsb: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.
translations.kjv: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
translations.asv: These are springs without water, and mists driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness hath been reserved.
